title: vocals
style: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted power chords and descending chromatic riffs. A gritty, high-tenor male vocal delivers melodic lines with occasional rasp and vibrato. The drums feature a prominent snare and active double-kick patterns during transitions. A thick, overdriven bass guitar follows the guitar riffs closely. The arrangement is dense with layered vocal harmonies in the chorus. Key of E minor. 145 BPM.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, driving drum beat]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals with slight grit]
Is that a face from the past?
Wondering how long it would last
Your drive for living has gone
Well, I still think you belong

[Chorus]
[layered vocal harmonies, heavy guitar chords]
In youth to be so strong
Never things could be wrong
For you let them lead you astray
You just found out how to play
Now you can't even understand
Why reality let go of your hand
You dug a hole so deep
Well now you feel nothing but empty
It's time now to comply
You were on a wild ride

[Verse 2]
Are you to lose today?
I know it's not your way
Never could get you down
Flying so far and away

[Chorus]
[full band intensity]
I can't believe you want to go
It's not all over, you know
You dug a hole so deep
Well now you feel nothing but empty
It's time now to comply
You were on a wild ride

[Bridge]
[guitar solo with wah-wah effect]

[Verse 3]
Listen to your mind
It's not like your, your kind
I've seen others well
You are once again now a shining star
Challenge not to lose
Now only life they choose

[Chorus]
You dug a hole so deep
Well now you feel nothing but empty
It's time now to comply
You were on a wild ride
You are far from the end
Not saying this to pretend
I now know that I am right
I can see you're gonna fight
Fight, fight, ba-ba-ba-ya
[final drum hit and guitar feedback]
